items.title: Oil prices sink, stock futures rally as U.S. and Iran pause attacks, Wall Street awaits busy week
items.description: U.S. stock-index futures rallied and oil prices tumbled on Sunday as the U.S. and Iran took a pause from fighting, and as Wall Street gears up for the Fed’s meeting and key earnings reports from Big T
